title: UIA-HYP CUP 2026 International Student Competition in Architectural Design
description: Design communities for urban, suburban, or rural living. For architecture students worldwide, in teams of up to 4.
descriptionDetailed: The only UIA-endorsed international student architecture competition held annually in mainland China, now in its 15th edition. Under the topic Villagers: Urban, Suburban, Rural, students propose community designs across one of three ways of living, with a first prize of RMB 80,000. Free for architecture students worldwide.

prize.description: 1st Prize (1 team): RMB 80,000 and certificate. 2nd Prize (5 teams): RMB 15,000 each. 3rd Prize (12 teams): RMB 8,000 each. Several honorable mentions receive certificates. Advisors of prize-winning projects also receive certificates.

audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to architecture and related-major students worldwide, including full-time undergraduates, master's students, PhD students, and students graduating in 2026. Individual or team entries are accepted, with up to 4 members and up to 2 academic advisors per team.
